verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a payments API platform like EBANX, but the evidence pack never mentions one. The pack documents a REST API, a hosted checkout, an API Reference request tool, an llms.txt file and Agent Skills for AI coding assistants. These are adjacent developer and AI aids, not a command-line tool, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
